channel.title: Reads with Colin
channel.description: Books that change how you see — and what you do next. · 学而知之，忘而破之，习而新之。 A weekly letter on the books worth keeping. 每周一封推荐好书的来信。

item.title: Atomic Habits, identity change and the quiet power of 1% — 《原子习惯》：身份改变，与 1% 的安静力量
item.description: Why the smallest choices, repeated daily, end up changing who you are. A reading note on James Clear's Atomic Habits. — 微小的选择日复一日，最终改变了你是谁。詹姆斯·克利尔《原子习惯》读书笔记。

item.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow — lazy brains and the anchors in your head — 《思考，快与慢》：偷懒的大脑，与你脑中的锚
item.description: Kahneman's two systems — and why the slower one deserves more of your week. — 卡尼曼的两个系统——以及为什么你的一周里，应该把更多时间留给慢的那个。

item.title: Walden — deliberate living and the luxury of enough — 《瓦尔登湖》：清醒地生活，与"足够"的奢侈
item.description: Thoreau's two-year experiment in simplifying life — and what still survives 170 years later. — 梭罗在湖畔的两年实验——以及 170 年后，依然没被时间磨掉的几句话。
